name: Miro AI
summary: Miro's collaborative whiteboard with AI features.
description: Miro AI adds idea, diagram and mockup generation, sticky-note clustering and summaries, and boards built from documents. It supports workshops and product planning.

howToUse.title: Sign up on Miro AI
howToUse.description: Create an account at the official URL if you need saved work or billing.

howToUse.title: Complete onboarding
howToUse.description: Follow the product tour or connect the first integration it asks for.

howToUse.title: Run a first task
howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.

howToUse.title: Review outputs
howToUse.description: Export, share, or connect to your stack before scaling usage.

features_fr: Maquettes et tableaux à partir de documents
summary_fr: Tableau blanc collaboratif Miro avec fonctions IA.
description_fr: Miro AI ajoute au tableau blanc la génération d'idées, de diagrammes et de maquettes, le regroupement et le résumé de post-its, et des tableaux à partir de documents. Il accompagne les ateliers et la planification produit.
